input.text: Driver Carl Birkelane says they are still unwell and not safe to drive right now; unsure about tomorrow's pickup. They will not board the 12:25 Aalborg train (Copenhagen time) unless clearly fit, and will give a definite yes/no by 11:30 Copenhagen time today; no answer by then means no.

The driver's train (Aalborg 12:25 → Copenhagen 16:45), flight (Copenhagen 18:45 → Hamburg 20:00) and Hamburg hotel tonight are booked. Boarding not confirmed. These costs are at risk if the driver drops out.

Both endpoint contacts are unconfirmed: Daniel Hollowmere at pickup (residential garage, who opens it and releases keys) and Eva Hollowmere at delivery (named receiver must accept car and keys). No tracking on record.
